article.title: Reporting of adoption.
article.content: Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, information regarding all adoption orders issued by the 6[District Magistrate], shall be forwarded to Authority on monthly basis in the manner as provided in the adoption regulations framed by the Authority, so as to enable Authority to maintain the data on adoption.
article.html:
64Reporting of adoption.

Section 64 · Chapter VIII · page 34 of the Act

Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, information regarding all adoption orders issued by the 6[District Magistrate], shall be forwarded to Authority on monthly basis in the manner as provided in the adoption regulations framed by the Authority, so as to enable Authority to maintain the data on adoption.

6 Subs. by Act 23 of 2021, s. 23, for “concerned courts” (w.e.f. 1-9-2022).
